offers_products.reason: Makes and sells packaged shelf-stable and frozen foods under brands like Green Giant, Crisco, Ortega, Cream of Wheat.

offers_services.reason: Sells branded packaged foods; no main service offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Consumer food brands sold through stores; shoppers choose the brands for their families.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to grocery retailers, mass merchants, club stores and foodservice customers who buy for resale.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat orders of packaged food staples by retailers and shoppers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Packaged pantry foods are staples; demand holds in downturns, though shoppers may trade down.

big_ticket.reason: Low-priced, frequently purchased packaged food items.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured branded food products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Sells mainly to households via retail; large grocers are channel buyers, and consumers are the end buyers.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates manufacturing plants but relies partly on co-packers; growth is mainly through brand acquisitions.

notes: Large-customer and asset-heavy answers are judgment calls: sales are concentrated in big grocers, and B&G runs some own plants.
